statement: Zheng / MT-Bench is the cleanest comparator target because its benchmark, human judgments, and judging pipeline are public enough to support a fair audit.
rationale: The paper and official artifacts expose the benchmark surface and human labels unusually clearly.
keyAssumptions: Protocol-faithful reconstruction is acceptable even if historical GPT-4 behavior cannot be exactly replayed.
validationCriteria: Public artifacts cover benchmark items, human labels, and the judging workflow.
A comparator audit can use archived or reconstructed judge outputs fairly.
critiquePoints: Exact replay still depends on paper-era GPT-4 behavior.
